papers.title: RuleTrek: Benchmarking Agentic Rule Reasoning in Complex Scenarios
papers.summary: RuleTrek is a multi-domain benchmark that evaluates large language model agents on identifying, deducing, and applying domain-specific rules across complex, multi-file scenarios, revealing substantial performance gaps.

papers.title: CLASHarness: Benchmarking Multi-Agent Conflict in Computer Use via a Controllable and Verifiable Generation Pipeline
papers.summary: CLASHarness introduces a controllable framework for generating verifiable multi-agent conflicts in computer-use tasks, revealing that frontier vision-language models struggle with verifying ground truth, resolving conflicts, and coordinating shared resources.

papers.title: The Thinking Leakage in Reinforcement Learning for LLMs
papers.summary: Reinforcement learning gains in hybrid reasoning models' NO-THINK mode largely stem from reactivating existing THINK-mode reasoning rather than learning new capabilities.

papers.title: LabInstruct: Benchmarking Situated Instructional Video Generation for Lab Procedures
papers.summary: LabInstruct evaluates AI-generated instructional videos for real laboratory tasks and reveals that visual plausibility does not ensure procedural correctness.

papers.title: SwarmRSI: Recursive Self-Improvement through Evolving Scientific Agent Swarm
papers.summary: SwarmRSI evolves scientific agent swarms through feedback-guided mutation and complementary recombination to enable recursive self-improvement across research tasks.

papers.title: APEX-Harm: Evaluating Agent Safety in Shared Professional Workspaces
papers.summary: APEX-Harm evaluates long-horizon agent vulnerabilities to injection attacks across large multi-tool workspaces, revealing high success rates for script-based attacks despite correct task outputs.

papers.title: History Replays Itself: Unleashing Long-Context Capability in Linear Attention
papers.summary: NoteBank augments linear attention models with a sparse episodic memory that stores selected text and replays it through native computation, greatly improving long-context retrieval without extra training or significant overhead.

papers.title: Joint Subspace Sparse Attention for Efficient Long-Context Decoding
papers.summary: Joint Subspace Sparse Attention improves long-context decoding by learning a shared low-dimensional query-key subspace for accurate token selection and using a gather-free kernel, achieving near-full accuracy with substantially higher throughput.

papers.title: LLM-to-Flow Distillation: Teaching Natural Language Goals to Scientific Generators
papers.summary: LLM-to-Flow Distillation aligns scientific generators with high-level discovery goals by using a frozen LLM to build adaptive curricula and distill preferences via DPO, enabling control over peptide and small-molecule design.

papers.title: ProbabilityBench: Model Evaluation and Calibration with Exact Ground-Truth Uncertainty
papers.summary: ProbabilityBench supplies exact instance-level class probabilities across simulated text domains to directly evaluate model calibration and benchmark standard metrics against known ground truth.

papers.title: From Failures to Learnable Worlds: Policy-Conditioned Environment Generation for Navigation Agents
papers.summary: WEDGE guides environment generation for embodied navigation agents by diagnosing policy failure modes and constructing targeted training scenarios that address specific weaknesses.

papers.title: Rethinking Projector Training in Multimodal LLMs
papers.summary: PORTAL initializes multimodal projectors without paired data by aligning vision and language feature distributions via optimal transport, matching standard training performance while eliminating projector training.

papers.title: StartLux-Decision: AutoThink Decision Models with Reinforcement Learning for Calibrated Deliberative Decisions
papers.summary: StartLux-Decision introduces efficient and adaptive decision models using single-pass prediction and confidence-guided reasoning, trained via a three-stage pipeline with RLCD² reinforcement learning, and evaluates them on Decision Index and the DecisionPivot benchmark.

papers.title: Glance Forcing: Making Bidirectional Diffusion Autoregressive at a Glance
papers.summary: Glance Forcing improves video generation efficiency by splitting denoising into specialized experts guided by stage-specific objectives, reducing training costs while improving quality.

papers.title: Choosing LLMs for Strategic Agent Interactions
papers.summary: Strategic model selection for game-theoretic LLM evaluation reveals that multi-armed bandit methods outperform embedding-based selectors but remain below fixed-model baselines against adaptive opponents.

papers.title: VASPO: Self-Distillation with Privileged Value Estimation
papers.summary: Value-Augmented Self-Distillation Policy Optimization integrates a self-teacher and critic within PPO to improve reasoning by combining token-level advantages with bounded probability ratios, boosting accuracy on mathematical benchmarks.

papers.title: Rethinking LLM-Guided Visual Question Answering: Does Deeper Knowledge Integration Really Help?
papers.summary: Shallow late fusion of LLM-generated reasoning guidance outperforms deep attention injection in knowledge-based VQA under limited data, highlighting that integration depth should align with the training regime.

papers.title: Jag: Direct Box Prediction for Efficient Visual Grounding
papers.summary: Jag adapts a compact pretrained multimodal model to predict bounding boxes directly via a regression head, improving grounding accuracy and reducing inference latency.

papers.title: To Align or Not To Align: Check Your COMPASS Before You Train
papers.summary: COMPASS estimates model-pair compatibility before alignment or merging by measuring local neighborhood overlap and paradigm limits, guiding resource allocation across cross-modal and merging tasks.

papers.title: AgentSafeEvo: Adversarial Co-Evolution for LLM Agent Safety
papers.summary: AgentSafeEvo uses adversarial co-evolution to train LLM agents to resist malicious tool-use attacks across diverse tasks without sacrificing general capabilities.

papers.title: Vela: Scaling Vision-Language-Action Models with Adaptive Action Curve Parametrization
papers.summary: Vela is a vision-language-action model that uses continuous spline-based trajectories to adapt temporal resolution for robot manipulation, improving long-horizon planning and local precision.

papers.title: Your Transformer Is Secretly Elastic
papers.summary: The method converts pre-trained transformers into elastic models that adapt continuously to varying computational budgets by jointly ranking and softly pruning individual neurons and attention heads across multiple sparsity targets without retraining.

papers.title: StreamErase: Towards Ultra-Fast Streaming Video Erasing
papers.summary: StreamErase enables real-time, streaming video object removal with sub-second latency by transferring erasing capabilities from a bidirectional model to an efficient unidirectional streaming generator using sliding-window causal attention with attention sinks.

papers.title: Self-Conditioning Enables Deep Sequential Reasoning in Flow Matching
papers.summary: Flow matching with self-conditioning enables deeper visual reasoning by allowing iterative sampling steps to increase expressive power beyond constant-depth limits.

papers.title: Drive3R: Block-wise Streaming Geometric Foundation Models for Autonomous Driving
papers.summary: Drive3R is a block-wise streaming geometric foundation model that enables scalable, long-horizon multi-view 3D reconstruction for autonomous driving by using block-wise causal attention and confidence-aware re-anchoring to reduce drift and maintain global consistency.

papers.title: Next-Concept Modeling: Fast, Parallel Coarse-to-Fine Text Generation
papers.summary: Next-Concept Modeling uses hierarchical discrete codes and parallel level-wise generation to accelerate diffusion language models while improving quality and reasoning performance.

papers.title: Cortex: Measurement-Gated Evolution and Pruning of Coding-Agent Skills and Rules
papers.summary: Cortex validates agent harness updates by replaying developer corrections, retaining only rules and skills that consistently improve performance without degrading tasks.

papers.title: The Agent Knew: Internal States Forecast Unauthorized Actions and Stop Them, and the Lies That Follow
papers.summary: Residual-stream forecasting detects unauthorized agent actions and false reports before they occur, enabling low-cost gating that reduces violations and prompt-injection attacks without harming task completion.

papers.title: VLX-Go: Robust Embodied Tracking through Multi-Stage Learning and On-Policy Refinement
papers.summary: A vision-language waypoint policy using staged multimodal training improves robot tracking of intended people among distractors and benefits from on-policy refinement.

papers.title: A Diagnostic Study of World-Space Human Recovery Under High Camera Dynamics
papers.summary: A scale mismatch between independently recovered camera and human estimates causes severe world-space drift in fast-motion dance videos, which is corrected by a closed-form rescaling method that stabilizes multi-person reconstruction without retraining.
